title: Cylindrical base
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On this coordinate system, initiate a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. Within this face, draw a single loop, and within this loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates (0.0075, 0.0075) with a radius of 0.0075 meters. Apply a scaling factor of 0.015 to the entire sketch to adjust its size accordingly. Rotate the scaled sketch using Euler angles of zero degrees and translate it using a vector of zero. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 meters, ensuring that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. This operation should create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical base are 0.015 meters in length, 0.015 meters in width, and 0.75 meters in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the cylindrical base
cylinder = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0075, 0.0075)  # Move the center of the circle to the specified position
    .circle(0.0075)  # Create a circle with the specified radius
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the circle to create the cylindrical base
)

# Create the rectangular top
rect = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0075, 0.0075)  # Move the center of the rectangle to the specified position
    .rect(0.015, 0.015)  # Create a rectangle with the specified dimensions
    .extrude(0.01)  # Extrude the rectangle to create the top part
)

# Create the small protrusion on one side of the top
protrusion = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0075, 0.0075)  # Move the center of the protrusion to the specified position
    .rect(0.005, 0.005)  # Create a smaller rectangle for the protrusion
    .extrude(0.005)  # Extrude the smaller rectangle to create the protrusion
)

# Combine the parts to form the final model
r = cylinder.union(rect).union(protrusion)

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the circular sketch
circle_center = (0.0075, 0.0075)
circle_radius = 0.0075
sketch = workplane.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder_height = 0.75
cylinder = sketch.extrude(cylinder_height)

# Create the rectangular protrusion
protrusion_width = 0.015
protrusion_length = 0.015
protrusion_height = 0.01  # Assuming a small height for the protrusion

# Create the rectangular protrusion sketch
protrusion_sketch = workplane.center(*circle_center).rect(protrusion_width, protrusion_length)

# Extrude the protrusion sketch
protrusion = protrusion_sketch.extrude(protrusion_height)

# Combine the cylinder and the protrusion
r = cylinder.union(protrusion)

import cadquery as cq

# Main shaft: thin vertical cylinder
shaft = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0055).extrude(0.75)

# Small collar/cap at the bottom of the shaft
collar = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0075).extrude(0.012)

# Combine the shaft and collar into the final part
r = shaft.union(collar)
